title: Kinuku language — Grokipedia
text: Kinuku language Kinuku (also known as Nu, Kinugu, or Tinu) is a Niger-Congo language belonging to the Kainji branch, specifically the Eastern Kainji subgroup, spoken by the Kinuku people, a small ethnic community in southeastern Kaduna State, Nigeria.
